facts.fact: 叙述者认定这份手稿不能让任何人读到，包括出版方和她自己认识的人
facts.anchor: I can never allow another soul to read this manuscript

facts.fact: 姐姐死后她把责任全揽到自己身上，把自己写成加害者
facts.anchor: Instead, I shouldered the blame, and cast myself as the perpetrator

facts.fact: 是 Genevieve 让她明白承认自己是受害者并不等于软弱
facts.anchor: But it was Genevieve who taught me that owning one’s victimhood isn’t a weakness

facts.fact: 把这一课真正落到她心里的是 Caro
facts.anchor: it was Caro who brought the lesson home

facts.fact: 她原先以为 Eli 被药得神志不清，实际并非如此
facts.anchor: It turns out that Eli Pratt wasn’t as drugged out as I had assumed he was

facts.fact: 顶着 Austin Gregory 这个名字在狱中的人死于芬太尼过量
facts.anchor: had died in prison of a fentanyl overdose of his own

facts.fact: 那所监狱随后不久就关掉了
那个丢了监狱长职位的人改做私人教练，做得还不错
facts.anchor: He’s been doing well as a personal trainer, though

facts.fact: Denny 查到她父母仍住在她从小长大的那栋房子里
facts.anchor: They’re in the same house. The one you grew up in

facts.fact: 她想到台地、高原与孤峰这些古怪形状都是侵蚀造成的

facts.fact: 她还没走到门口，门就先开了
